name: task-tracker
description: Task tracker - internship coding exercise (choose Node.js or Python backend)

scripts.install:node: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend-node install
scripts.install:python: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && python -m pip install -r backend-python/requirements.txt
scripts.dev:node: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend-node run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:python: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,green "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 4000 --app-dir backend-python" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
